episodes.name: A Hero for Earth
episodes.overview: The spirit of the Earth, Gaia, summons five teenagers to join her in battling ecological destruction and pollution. Their first fight is to keep Hoggish Greedly's oil rig from destroying a coastline.

episodes.name: Rain of Terror
episodes.overview: Skumm and his rat pack threaten to destroy a city with acid rain.

episodes.name: Beast of the Temple
episodes.overview: Greedly and Rigger strip-mine Thailand for rubies.

episodes.name: Skumm Lord
episodes.overview: Skumm peddles a polluted drink that turns consumers into rodent zombies.

episodes.name: Deadly Ransom
episodes.overview: Captain Planet is held hostage by Nukem, Blight and MAL.

episodes.name: The Conqueror
episodes.overview: An aggressive and sneaky Earth spirit named Zarm tricks the teens into disobeying Gaia, sparking a dangerous game that threatens to lead to nuclear war.

episodes.name: Last of Her Kind
episodes.overview: The Planeteers fight to save the African elephants from extinction as Looten Plunder tries to corner the market in ivory.

episodes.name: The Dead Seas
episodes.overview: Greedly and Rigger plot to empty the oceans of fish.

episodes.name: Tree of Life
episodes.overview: Blight gains powers from the "Tree of Life" and threatens to use her new strength to destroy the redwood forest.

episodes.name: Volcano's Wrath
episodes.overview: Sludge solves the world's trash problem by dumping everything into a volcano, which then erupts.

episodes.name: Littlest Planeteer
episodes.overview: A little boy helps battle a smog monster.

episodes.name: A World Below Us
episodes.overview: A dumping operation threatens an underwater city.

episodes.name: Plunder Dam
episodes.overview: Plunder dams an African river, leaving the locals without the food or water the waterway provided.

episodes.name: Meltdown Syndrome
episodes.overview: Nukem's radioactive presence at a leaking nuclear power plant triggers a meltdown.

episodes.name: Smog Hog
episodes.overview: Greedly creates a pollution-intensive car but his own son becomes a victim of the resulting smog and pollution.

episodes.name: Polluting by Computer
episodes.overview: Sludge and Blight break into government computers and transform all national parks into toxic waste dumps.

episodes.name: Don't Drink the Water
episodes.overview: Plunder, Skumm and Greedly pollute the nation's water supply.

episodes.name: Kwame's Crisis
episodes.overview: A depressed Kwame leaves the Planeteers when no one seems to care that Sludge is burying a small town in garbage.

episodes.name: Ozone Hole
episodes.overview: Nukem decimates the ozone layer so he can feast on ultra-violet rays.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Pollution
episodes.overview: Looten Plunder provokes tribal warfare so he can sell arms to both sides.

episodes.name: Population Bomb
episodes.overview: Wheeler is stranded on an island of humanoid mice on the brink of population overload.

episodes.name: Mission to Save Earth (1)
episodes.overview: The teens cross paths with Cold Warrior Commander Clash, but their true opponent is Captain Pollution, a creation of Blight's.

episodes.name: Mission to Save Earth (2)
episodes.overview: Commander Clash joins the Planeteers to stop the eco-villains and Captain Pollution.

episodes.name: Two Futures (1)
episodes.overview: A disgruntled Wheeler uses a time machine to travel to the past to stop himself from becoming a Planeteer.

episodes.name: Two Futures (2)
episodes.overview: Wheeler's attempt to keep his former self from joining the Planeteers has grave consequences for the planet.

episodes.name: Heat Wave
episodes.overview: Blight creates a mini greenhouse effect over Hope Island, threatening Gaia's life.
